name: Carolina Yarn & Fabrics Inc
old_description: Carolina Yarn and Fabrics, LLC, based in Laurens, SC, is a leading manufacturer and principal supplier of highly engineered fabric-formed concrete erosion control and scour protection systems. These systems have been utilized for more than 40 years around the world.
about:
Carolina Yarn and Fabrics, LLC, based in Laurens, South Carolina, has been a manufacturer and principal supplier of highly engineered fabric-formed concrete erosion control and scour protection systems since the ARMORFORM® trade name was established in 1984. The company draws together teams of project managers, engineers, and production and field service managers dedicated to sustainable solutions.

The firm produces ARMORFORM® fabric-formed concrete systems, which use double-layer woven geo-textiles engineered exclusively as forms for casting concrete erosion control revetments and linings. The geo-textiles are woven from polyester and/or nylon yarns and designed with specific mechanical and hydraulic properties. Installation involves positioning the fabric forms and pumping high-strength, fine-aggregate concrete, either underwater or on dry land. By 2002, more than 50 million square feet of ARMORFORM® had been installed worldwide, including projects inside the Arctic Circle and at the Olmsted Locks and Dam on the Ohio River.

The company serves engineering firms, government agencies, and commercial clients across infrastructure, water, environment, industry, and energy sectors. Notable references include acceptance by the Mine Safety and Health Administration for mining facilities in 1993, U.S. Navy approval for underwater ballast and protection of pipelines and communication cables in 2002, and exclusive collaboration with the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers on scour protection for the Olmsted Locks and Dam in 2008.

Carolina Yarn and Fabrics emphasizes engineered products, comprehensive technical support, and responsive delivery, which the company says have resulted in most projects being repeat work with long-standing clients. The focus on sustainable solutions for infrastructure, water, environment, industry, and energy underpins its approach.
